Definition
[Properly discontinuous action] 1. Definition 8.2.1\group group actionsSource: thurston:page-0189 An action of a group on a locally compact space $X$ is properly discontinuous when, for every compact $K\subset X$, only finitely many $\gamma $ satisfy $\gamma K\cap K\neq \varnothing $.
